text: Level two, question three: A, B and C invest twenty thousand, thirty thousand and fifty thousand rupees for twelve, eight and six months, and the profit is thirty-nine thousand; find each share. Question four: A and B invest forty thousand and fifty thousand rupees for the same period, and the business makes a loss of six thousand three hundred; how much does each partner lose? Question five: A and B invest for the same period, and their profits are in the ratio five to three; A invested forty-five thousand rupees; how much did B invest?
